notes.status: Confirmed 12 Nov 2026 by Sadman Shaharier Mahim (FD-041): the three stops are as drafted. T07.14, TASK-07 open point 15.
notes.shape: start names the site default_start (pipeline/sites/gale_boxwork/site.json); stops are POI ids in walking order. No coordinates are copied: the plan store resolves both from the site bundle (T07.05).

stop_picks.poi-boxwork-ridge: Stop 1, science. 01 E.2 step 3 opens 'Boxwork ridge'.
stop_picks.poi-sulfate-contact: Stop 2, resource (stop_type resource in its POI file). 01 E.1: the crew are at stop 2, a hydrated-sulfate resource stop, when the storm starts; 01 E.2 steps 3-4 add a science stop and a resource stop; step 5 drags stop 2 onto a steep slope. FR-45: at least one resource POI in the demo plan. Its ISRU framing is assumed.
stop_picks.poi-monte-grande-hollow: Stop 3, science: the hollow half of the ridge/hollow pair started at stop 1. The walk now backtracks north from the sulfate contact to the hollow (latitudes read from the POI files).

notes.defaults_source: docs/specs/05_Backend_and_Database_Schema.md MissionScenario; every value is a 05 default and shows as assumed in the UI. Ranges: 02 section E.3. vehicle_param_set pr1-assumed matches scenarios/storm-sol4190/param_sets/pr1-assumed.json.
decisions: eva_start_utc is omitted on purpose (FD-042): no site default is invented, because 05 Site has no such field. The planner's start field takes the loaded scenario's eva_start_utc from the Hab Core (GET /api/session, N-05); with no Hab Core the field stays empty and SCR-04 shows 'Invalid input - set a start time'. The storm scenario (01 E.1) is 2024-05-20 / sol 4190; the time of day comes from the scenario file when it exists (scenarios/storm-sol4190, T21.08).

The dose shown is the one the worker computes from the planned EVA total (FD-043): the demo uses the 6 h default of max_eva_duration_h, and SCR-05/SCR-07 show the computed dose. 01 E.2 step 8's narrated dose becomes 'the dose shown (computed from the planned EVA total)'.
